```{r load-rds, include=FALSE,eval=TRUE}
# check_richness_merge_match_type ----
check_richness_merge_match_type <- function(physeq_obj, richness_phylobj) {
  richness_df <- estimate_richness(richness_phylobj)
  richness_ids <- rownames(richness_df)
  
  sample_df <- as(sample_data(physeq_obj), "data.frame")
  
  if (all(richness_ids %in% rownames(sample_df))) {
    match_type <- "rownames"
  } else if ("X16S_ID" %in% colnames(sample_df) &&
             all(richness_ids %in% sample_df$X16S_ID)) {
    match_type <- "X16S_ID"
  } else if ("ITS_ID" %in% colnames(sample_df) &&
             all(richness_ids %in% sample_df$ITS_ID)) {
    match_type <- "ITS_ID"
  } else {
    match_type <- "no match"
  }
  
  cat("Best match type for richness merge:", match_type, "\n")
}

# add add_crosskingdom_richness / alpha div ----

# Fun_wholecommunity1<-Fun_wholecommunity
# Bac_wholecommunity1<-Bac_wholecommunity

# add_crosskingdom_richness ----
add_crosskingdom_richness <- function(physeq_obj, richness_phylobj, prefix) {
  # richness_phylobj <- Bac_wholecommunity1
  # richness_phylobj <- Bac_wholecommunity1
  richness_df <- estimate_richness(richness_phylobj)
  cat("first richness_df rownames:", head(rownames(richness_df)), "\n")
  richness_ids <- rownames(richness_df)
  # cat("first richness_ids", head(richness_ids), "\n")
  richness_df$Richness_ID <- rownames(richness_df)
  colnames(richness_df) <- paste0(prefix, colnames(richness_df))
  cat("richness_df column names", colnames(richness_df), "\n")
  
  sample_df <- as(sample_data(physeq_obj), "data.frame")
  sample_df$SampleRow <- rownames(sample_df)  # preserve original rownames
  cat("first sample_df rownames:", head(sample_df$SampleRow), "\n")
  
  # check match type/merge column
  match_type <- NULL
  if (all(richness_ids %in% rownames(sample_df))) {
    match_type <- "rownames"
  } else if ("X16S_ID" %in% colnames(sample_df) &&
             all(richness_ids %in% sample_df$X16S_ID)) {
    match_type <- "X16S_ID"
  } else if ("ITS_ID" %in% colnames(sample_df) &&
             all(richness_ids %in% sample_df$ITS_ID)) {
    match_type <- "ITS_ID"
  } else {
    match_type <- "no match"
  }
  
  cat("Best match type for richness merge:", match_type, "\n")
  
  # merge richness to sample df
  if (match_type == "rownames") {
    merged_df <- cbind(sample_df, richness_df[rownames(sample_df), , drop = FALSE])
  } else if (match_type == "X16S_ID") {
    merged_df <- merge(sample_df, richness_df, by.x = "X16S_ID", by.y = "Bac_Richness_ID", all.x = TRUE)
    rownames(merged_df) <- merged_df$SampleRow
  } else if (match_type == "ITS_ID") {
    merged_df <- merge(sample_df, richness_df, by.x = "ITS_ID", by.y = "Fun_Richness_ID", all.x = TRUE)
    rownames(merged_df) <- merged_df$SampleRow
  } else {
    stop("Houston, we have a problem!")
  }
  
  # Clean up and assign new sample_data
  merged_df$SampleRow <- NULL
  sample_data(physeq_obj) <- sample_data(merged_df)

  message("Richness data merged using: ", match_type)
  return(physeq_obj)

}
```

# Regional species pool: 𝛄 - Gamma diversity of sites ($\gamma_{site}$) and species richness ($\alpha_{site}$)

\
\

## Calculate site gamma ($\gamma_{site}$) {.hidden .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r gamma-Bac-calc-site, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE, cache=TRUE}
bwc_alpha_Site <- data.frame(sample_data(Bac_wholecommunity),
                        estimate_richness(Bac_wholecommunity))

# add Site gamma to *wc_alpha_Site
if (!"Bac_gamma_Site" %in% colnames(bwc_alpha_Site)) { bwc_alpha_Site <- bwc_alpha_Site %>% left_join(data.frame("Site" = names(Bac_gamma_Site), "Bac_gamma_Site" = Bac_gamma_Site), by = "Site") }

# add sample number per site
if (!"nsamples_per_Site" %in% colnames(bwc_alpha_Site)) {
  bwc_alpha_Site$nsamples_per_Site <- ave(as.numeric(factor(bwc_alpha_Site$SampleID)), bwc_alpha_Site$Site, FUN = function(x) length(unique(x)))
}

# add gamma_over_n per site
if (!"Bac_Gamma_over_n" %in% colnames(bwc_alpha_Site)) {
  bwc_alpha_Site$Bac_Gamma_over_n <- (bwc_alpha_Site$Bac_gamma_Site / bwc_alpha_Site$nsamples_per_Site)
}

Bac_gamma_Site<-vegan::specnumber(phylo2vegan_OTU(Bac_wholecommunity),
                  groups = phylo2vegan_sd(Bac_wholecommunity)$Site,
                  MARGIN=1) # MARGIN = 1, finds # of species; MARGIN = 2, finds frequencies of species

Bac_gamma_Site2<-prettyNum(Bac_gamma_Site,big.mark = ',')

Bac_gamma_Site2<-cbind(prettyNum(Bac_gamma_Site,big.mark = ','),
  (as.data.frame(attr(md_bwc_Site, "n"))[,2]))
  
# mean observed alpha by Site
Bac_obs_mean_alpha<-aggregate(Observed~Site,bwc_alpha_Site,mean)

# obs/site gamma
bwc_alpha_Site$Obs_overSitegamma<-bwc_alpha_Site$Observed/bwc_alpha_Site$Bac_gamma_Site

Bac_Obs_overSitegamma_mean<-aggregate(Obs_overSitegamma~Site,bwc_alpha_Site,mean)

Bac_Obs_overSitegamma_sd<-as.data.frame(aggregate(bwc_alpha_Site$Obs_overSitegamma, list(bwc_alpha_Site$Site), FUN=sd))
colnames(Bac_Obs_overSitegamma_sd)[1]<-"Site"
colnames(Bac_Obs_overSitegamma_sd)[2]<-"Obs_overSitegamma_sd"

# add sd to mean of prop gamma per sample by Site 
Bac_Obs_overSitegamma_mean2<-cbind(Bac_Obs_overSitegamma_mean,"Obs_overSitegamma_sd"=Bac_Obs_overSitegamma_sd$Obs_overSitegamma_sd)
colnames(Bac_Obs_overSitegamma_mean2)[2]<-"Obs_overSitegamma_mean"

# aggregate # of grass hosts per site
ngrass_persite.df<-aggregate(ngrass_persite~Site,sd,mean)

# aggregate gamma_over_n
Bac_Gamma_over_n_persite.df<-aggregate(Bac_Gamma_over_n~Site,bwc_alpha_Site,mean)


# Bac_gamma_SiteFREQ<-vegan::specnumber(phylo2vegan_OTU(Bac_wholecommunity),
#                   groups = phylo2vegan_sd(Bac_wholecommunity)$Site,
#                   MARGIN=2) # MARGIN = 1, finds # of species; MARGIN = 2, finds frequencies of species

# does BLM have 4689 unique otus?
# BLM<-subset_samples(Bac_wholecommunity,Site=="BLM")
# BLM <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(BLM) > 0, BLM)


Bac_gamma_Site3temp<-as.data.frame(
  cbind("Gamma (# total unique OTUs)" = Bac_gamma_Site,
        "ngrass_persite" = as.numeric(ngrass_persite.df$ngrass_persite),
        "n (# of samples per site)"=(as.data.frame(attr(md_bwc_Site, "n"))[,2]),
        "Gamma_over_n" = as.numeric(round(Bac_Gamma_over_n_persite.df$Bac_Gamma_over_n,1)),
        "Observed mean 𝝰" = as.numeric(round(Bac_obs_mean_alpha$Observed,1)),
        "mean prop. of gamma / sample" = as.numeric(Bac_Obs_overSitegamma_mean2$Obs_overSitegamma_mean),
        "sd prop. of gamma / sample" = as.numeric(Bac_Obs_overSitegamma_mean2$Obs_overSitegamma_sd)
        )
)

Bac_gamma_Site3<-cbind("Gamma (# total unique OTUs)"=Bac_gamma_Site2[,1],
                       "n (# of samples per site)"=(as.data.frame(attr(md_bwc_Site, "n"))[,2]),
                       "# of grass hosts per site" = Bac_gamma_Site3temp$ngrass_persite,
                       "Gamma / n" = prettyNum(Bac_gamma_Site3temp$Gamma_over_n, big.mark = ","),
                       "Observed mean 𝝰" = prettyNum(Bac_gamma_Site3temp$`Observed mean 𝝰`,big.mark = ","),
                       "mean prop. of gamma detected per sample" = round(Bac_gamma_Site3temp$`mean prop. of gamma / sample`,3),
                       "SD prop. of gamma detected per sample" = round(Bac_gamma_Site3temp$`sd prop. of gamma / sample`,3)
  )
```

```{r diversity-summary-inline-group-labels, echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
compare_symbol <- function(bac, fun, tol = 1e-6) {
  if (abs(bac - fun) < tol) "=" else if (bac > fun) ">" else "<"
}

# Raw data
bac_vals <- list(

  alpha = bwc_alpha_Site$Observed,

  gamma = Fun_gamma_Site,
  alpha = fwc_alpha_Site$Observed,
  mean_alpha = Fun_obs_mean_alpha$Observed

# Function to generate summary rows
make_rows <- function(label, bac_vec, fun_vec, digits_range = 1, digits_mean = 0, digits_sd = 0) {
  tibble(
    Metric = c("min", "max", "mean ± sd"),
    Bacteria = c(
      round(min(bac_vec), digits_range),
      round(max(bac_vec), digits_range),
      paste0(round(mean(bac_vec), digits_mean), " ± ", round(sd(bac_vec), digits_sd))
    ),
    `B > F` = c(
      compare_symbol(min(bac_vec), min(fun_vec)),
      compare_symbol(max(bac_vec), max(fun_vec)),
      compare_symbol(mean(bac_vec), mean(fun_vec))
    ),
    Fungi = c(
      round(min(fun_vec), digits_range),
      round(max(fun_vec), digits_range),
      paste0(round(mean(fun_vec), digits_mean), " ± ", round(sd(fun_vec), digits_sd))
    )
  ) %>%
    add_row(Metric = paste0("**_", label, "_**"), Bacteria = "", `B > F` = "", Fungi = "", .before = 1)
}

# Combine all rows

  make_rows("γ<sub>site</sub> diversity", bac_vals$gamma, fun_vals$gamma, digits_range = 0),

  make_rows("Site mean α", bac_vals$mean_alpha, fun_vals$mean_alpha, digits_range = 0)
)

# Final table

  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
```

# Mean beta dissimilarities by Site

\

## Background 

\

If two groups of sampling units are truly different (e.g. in their species composition), then average of the within-group compositional dissimilarities should be less than the average of the dissimilarities between two random collection of sampling units drawn from the entire population.\

**Within-group (Site) values should be << the overall/global average if true difference in location (differences in mean *or* dispersion) exists.**\

This difference may be one of location (differences in mean) or one of spread (differences in within-group distance). That is, it may find a significant difference between two groups simply because one of those groups has a greater dissimilarities among its sampling units.\
\


```{r mean-diss-bySite-Bac-NEW, include=FALSE,eval=TRUE, cache=TRUE}
Bac_wc_sorensen_distmat <- as.matrix(betapart::beta.pair(vegan::decostand(phylo2vegan_OTU(Bac_wholecommunity), method = "pa"), index.family = "sorensen")$beta.sor)

Bac_wc_sorensen_dist<-as.dist(Bac_wc_sorensen_distmat)

# Function meandist calculates a matrix of mean within-cluster dissimilarities (diagonal) and between-cluster dissimilarities (off-diagonal elements), and an attribute n of grouping counts. 
md_Bwc_Site<-meandist(Bac_wc_sorensen_dist, 
                      phylo2vegan_sd(Bac_wholecommunity)$Site)

md_Bwc_Site.r <- round(md_Bwc_Site,digits = 3)

# Diagonal elements = mean within-group dissimilarity
  # extract the diagonals directly from matrix, preserving names in 
  # vectorized output
  md_Bwc_Site.df.self <- diag(md_Bwc_Site.r)

# Off-diagonals = mean between-group dissimilarity
  md_Bwc_Site.df.noself <- md_Bwc_Site.r
  diag(md_Bwc_Site.df.noself) <- NA
  md_Bwc_Site.df.noself_vec <- as.vector(md_Bwc_Site.df.noself)
```

## Bacterial vs. fungal mean dissimilarity by Site

```{r compare-meandist-summary, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Extract summaries
sum_bac <- summary(md_bwc_Site)
sum_fun <- summary(md_Fwc_Site)

# Extract key values
mean_bac_within <- round(sum_bac$W, 4)
mean_fun_within <- round(sum_fun$W, 4)
mean_bac_between <- round(sum_bac$B, 4)
mean_fun_between <- round(sum_fun$B, 4)
mean_bac_overall <- round(sum_bac$D, 4)
mean_fun_overall <- round(sum_fun$D, 4)

# Comparison symbol
compare_symbol <- function(bac, fun, tol = 1e-6) {
  if (abs(bac - fun) < tol) {
    "="
  } else if (bac > fun) {
    ">"
  } else {
    "<"
  }
}

comp_col <- c(
  compare_symbol(mean_bac_within, mean_fun_within),
  compare_symbol(mean_bac_between, mean_fun_between),
  compare_symbol(mean_bac_overall, mean_fun_overall)
)

# Build comparison table
summary_table <- tibble(
  Metric = c("Mean within-group", "Mean between-group", "Overall mean"),
  Bacteria = c(mean_bac_within, mean_bac_between, mean_bac_overall),
  `B < F` = comp_col,
  Fungi = c(mean_fun_within, mean_fun_between, mean_fun_overall)
)

# Print side-by-side comparison table
summary_table %>%
  kable(format = "html", caption = "Comparison of bacterial and fungal mean within- and between-Site Sørensen pairwise dissimilarities") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(2:4, extra_css = "text-align: center;")
```

[*Between-Kingdom Comparisons*]{.underline}

Among all samples, `r if (mean_fun_overall > mean_bac_overall) "fungi" else "bacteria"` had the higher overall mean Sørensen dissimilarity value across all sites and samples, with a value of `r max(mean_fun_overall, mean_bac_overall)` compared to `r min(mean_fun_overall, mean_bac_overall)` for `r if (mean_fun_overall > mean_bac_overall) "bacteria" else "fungi"`.

Within-site dissimilarity (`r mean_fun_within` for fungi, `r mean_bac_within` for bacteria) was `r if (mean_fun_within > mean_bac_within) "greater" else "lower"` for fungi, suggesting `r if (mean_fun_within > mean_bac_within) "higher spatial turnover or within-site heterogeneity" else "greater compositional cohesion within sites"` for the fungal community.

[*Among-Kingdom Comparisons*]{.underline}

For **bacteria**, the within-group dissimilarity (`r mean_bac_within`) was `r if (mean_bac_within < mean_bac_overall) "lower" else "higher"` than the overall average (`r mean_bac_overall`), indicating that samples from the same site were `r if (mean_bac_within < mean_bac_overall) "more compositionally similar" else "no more similar"` than samples across all sites. This pattern suggests that `r if (mean_bac_within < mean_bac_overall) "site identity explains some of the bacterial compositional variation" else "there may be high dispersion or weak clustering by site"`.

Similarly, for **fungi**, within-site dissimilarity was `r if (mean_fun_within < mean_fun_overall) "lower" else "higher"` than the overall dissimilarity, suggesting that fungal samples from the same site were `r if (mean_fun_within < mean_fun_overall) "more similar to each other" else "not particularly cohesive"` compared to the global average.

In both domains, a **between-group mean dissimilarity** (`r mean_bac_between` for bacteria, `r mean_fun_between` for fungi) greater than the within-group value suggests that Site did influence the presence/absence-based of compositional structure of communities — either due to differences in **mean community composition** (location) or **dispersion** (variability within sites).

```{r five-num-summary-bacteria-fungi, echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=F}
# Define function
five_num_summary_with_plot <- function(bac_vec, fun_vec, subcaption = "Bacteria vs Fungi Distances") {
  if (length(bac_vec) != length(fun_vec)) {
    stop("Vectors must be the same length")
  }

  # Paired statistical tests
  ttest_res <- tryCatch(t.test(bac_vec, fun_vec, paired = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  wilcox_res <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(bac_vec, fun_vec, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)

  ttest_p <- if (!is.null(ttest_res)) signif(ttest_res$p.value, 4) else NA
  wilcox_p <- if (!is.null(wilcox_res)) signif(wilcox_res$p.value, 4) else NA

  # Compute summaries
  bac_summary <- c(min(bac_vec, na.rm = TRUE),
                   quantile(bac_vec, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
                   median(bac_vec, na.rm = TRUE),
                   mean(bac_vec, na.rm = TRUE),
                   quantile(bac_vec, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
                   max(bac_vec, na.rm = TRUE))

  fun_summary <- c(min(fun_vec, na.rm = TRUE),
                   quantile(fun_vec, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
                   median(fun_vec, na.rm = TRUE),
                   mean(fun_vec, na.rm = TRUE),
                   quantile(fun_vec, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
                   max(fun_vec, na.rm = TRUE))

  # Comparison symbol column
  comp_symbol <- ifelse(
    abs(bac_summary - fun_summary) < 1e-6, "=",
    ifelse(bac_summary > fun_summary, ">", "<")
  )

  # Final summary table
  summary_df <- tibble(
    Statistic = c("Min", "1st Qu.", "Median", "Mean", "3rd Qu.", "Max"),
    Bacteria = bac_summary,
    `B > F` = comp_symbol,
    Fungi = fun_summary,
    Comparison = c(
      "", "",
      if (!is.na(wilcox_p)) paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", wilcox_p) else "",
      if (!is.na(ttest_p)) paste0("t-test p = ", ttest_p) else "",
      "", ""
    )
  )
  
  # Make long format for plotting
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    Kingdom = rep(c("Bacteria-Archaea", "Fungi"), each = length(bac_vec)),
    Distance = c(bac_vec, fun_vec)
  )

  # Boxplot
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Kingdom, y = Distance, fill = Kingdom)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 1, alpha = 0.3) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "Within-Site Mean Pairwise Dissimilarities by Kingdom",
      subtitle = subcaption,
      y = "Distance",
      x = NULL
    ) +
    # scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.25,1.05))+
    stat_compare_means(paired=T, label.y=0.9)+
    scale_fill_manual(values = domain_cols) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text = element_text(size=12,color="black"))

  # Display table
  print(
    summary_df %>%
      kable(format = "html", digits = 4, caption = "Five-number summary and paired stat tests for bacterial vs fungal mean within Site dissimilarities") %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
    column_spec(2:4, extra_css = "text-align: center;")
)
  

  # Show plot
  print(p)
}
bac_dist_vec <- md_bwc_Site.df.noself
fun_dist_vec <- md_Fwc_Site.df.noself

# Call function
# five_num_summary_compare(bac_dist_vec, fun_dist_vec)

# Call function with custom subcaption
five_num_summary_with_plot(bac_dist_vec, fun_dist_vec, subcaption = "All within-Site pairwise values, no strata or blocking")
```

# Beta dispersion (variance) by site

Implementation of Marti Anderson's PERMDISP2 procedure for the analysis of multivariate homogeneity of group dispersions (variances). `vegan::betadisper()` is a multivariate analogue of Levene's test for homogeneity of variances.  

## Calculate betadisp dispersions by site {.hidden .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r calc-betadisp-site, include=T,eval=TRUE,cache=TRUE}
# Fun
Fun_wc_sorensen_distmat <- as.matrix(sor.dist.list$Fun_wholecommunity)

Fun_wc_sorensen_dist<-as.dist(Fun_wc_sorensen_distmat)

## Calculate multivariate dispersions
betadisp_Site_Fun_addC <- betadisper(Fun_wc_sorensen_dist,
                            group = phylo2vegan_sd(Fun_wholecommunity)$Site,
                            type = "median", # type = "median" (distance from each sample unit to the spatial median of its group)
                            bias.adjust = T, # adjust for small sample bias in beta div estimates?
                            sqrt.dist = FALSE,
                            add = "lingoes")

# Bac
Bac_wc_sorensen_distmat <- as.matrix(beta.pair(decostand(phylo2vegan_OTU(Bac_wholecommunity), method = "pa"), index.family = "sorensen")$beta.sor)

Bac_wc_sorensen_dist<-as.dist(Bac_wc_sorensen_distmat)

## Calculate multivariate dispersions
betadisp_Site_Bac_addC <- betadisper(Bac_wc_sorensen_dist,
                            group = phylo2vegan_sd(Bac_wholecommunity)$Site,
                            type = "median", # type = "median" (distance from each sample unit to the spatial median of its group)
                            bias.adjust = T, # adjust for small sample bias in beta div estimates?
                            sqrt.dist = FALSE,
                            add = "lingoes")
```

```{r perform_anova_betadisper-function}
perform_anova_betadisper <- function(betadisper_object, grouping) {

  # Perform ANOVA 
  anova_result <- anova(betadisper_object)
  
  tidy_aov <- tidy(anova_result)
  tidy_df <- as.data.frame(tidy_aov)
  
  tidy_df$term[1] <- paste0(grouping)

  sum_squares_regression <- tidy_df$sumsq[1]
  sum_squares_residuals <- tidy_df$sumsq[2]

  R_squared <- sum_squares_regression /
            (sum_squares_regression + sum_squares_residuals)*100

  tidier_df <- data.frame(Term = character(),df = numeric(),
                          SumSq = numeric(),MeanSq = numeric(),
                          F.statistic = numeric(),
                          R_squared = numeric(),p.value = character(),
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  tidier_df[1,"Term"] <- tidy_df$term[1]
  tidier_df[2,"Term"] <- tidy_df$term[2]
  tidier_df[1:2,2] <- (tidy_df$df)[1:2]
  tidier_df$SumSq <- round(tidy_df$sumsq[1:2],2)
  tidier_df$MeanSq <- round(tidy_df$meansq[1:2],3)
  tidier_df$F.statistic <- round(tidy_df$statistic,2)
  tidier_df[1,"R_squared"] <- round(R_squared,2)
  tidier_df[2,"R_squared"] <- 100-(round(R_squared,2))
  tidier_df[1,"P.value"] <- prettyNum(tidy_df$p.value[1],digits=2)

  # Return ANOVA results for the specified taxa_of_interest
  return(tidier_df)
}
```

#### Permutation test for F with post-hoc Tukey's HSD {.tabset}

\
`vegan::permutest(betadisp_Site_Bac_addC, permutations = 999)`

```{r permutest-Site-pF-Bac, echo=F, cache=T}
## Permutation test for F
betadisp_Site_Bac.pmod <- permutest(betadisp_Site_Bac_addC, permutations = 999)

bdr2Bac<-prettyNum(betadisp_Site_Bac.pmod$tab$`Sum Sq`[1]/(sum(betadisp_Site_Bac.pmod$tab$`Sum Sq`)),digits=3)
```

```{r, echo=F,message=TRUE}
betadisp_Site_Bac.pmod
```


\
\

[Impact of site on explainable variability of beta dispersions:]{.underline}

Permuted $F$ = `r prettyNum(betadisp_Site_Bac.pmod$tab$F[1],digits=5)`\

Calculated $R^2$ = `r bdr2Bac`\

Site had a significant influence on bacterial community variance, explaining a calculated `r as.numeric(bdr2Bac)*100`% of the beta dispersion variability (permuted $F$ = `r round(betadisp_Site_Bac.pmod$tab$F[1],3)`).\
\

[**Post-hoc: compute Tukey HSD**]{.underline}\

`stats::TukeyHSD(betadisp_Site_Bac_addC, ordered = T)`

```{r, message=FALSE,results='hide'}
## Tukey's Honest Significant Differences
(betadisp_Site_Bac_addC.HSD <- TukeyHSD(betadisp_Site_Bac_addC, ordered = T, conf.level = 0.95))
bdHSDBacs<-subset(as.data.frame(betadisp_Site_Bac_addC.HSD$group),`p adj` < 0.05)
# plot(betadisp_Site_Bac_addC.HSD)
```


```{r, echo=TRUE}
bdHSDBacs %>%
  kbl(caption = "Bacteria: sites with significantly different beta dispersion, subset to p.adj < 0.05 (Tukey HSD)",
            align = 'c',
      digits = c(3,3,3,4)
      # col.names = c("Number of OTUs","Number of samples")
      # format.args = format(list(big.mark = ',', digit))
      ) %>%
  kable_styling() %>%
  scroll_box(width = "60%", height = "350px")
```

\

Of a total of `r nrow((betadisp_Site_Bac_addC.HSD)$group)` pairwise site-site comparisons, only `r nrow(bdHSDBacs)` were significantly different.
